status: OPEN (unverified from disk, residual of FIND-013)
description: The Stripe LM_MRR parser now requests the deeper expand path `expand[]=data.items.data.price` (loop.sh:53) and reads `it.get('price')` expecting an embedded object with `unit_amount`/`recurring.interval` (loop.sh:62-64). The review brief states this shape was 'confirmed by the builder' against a real live subscription, but no artifact evidencing that live capture (a saved real Stripe response, a dated log line, a comment citing a specific verified account/subscription ID) exists anywhere on disk in this skill directory, the spec, or STATE.md — grep across the repo and skill dir found no such evidence file. Separately, the one real production run captured in STATE.md (state/STATE.md:5, `lm_mrr_usd: 0.0`) is not proof the shape assumption is correct: with zero active subscriptions the `for s in d.get('data',[])` loop never executes, so this code path (walking into `items.data[].price`) has never actually been exercised against a real non-empty Stripe response, only against the hand-written fixture in test-loop.sh:17. The failure mode if the assumption is wrong is fail-safe (NA, per the existing broad except-clause at loop.sh:68), so this is not an anti-fake violation, but the claim that this is 'live-verified' is not substantiated by anything on disk.
